craft_notes: Sthāyin bhakti address. Hail mid-verse launches line 2 (semicolon→colon); datives cascade unbroken. Rejected: three-line split — couplet form is the song's gait; kept two. Read aloud: hail lifts, sea settles.

lines: To the welling drop and hum, to the self of sheer nectar — hail:
to light unending, to Śaṅkara, the milk-white sea.

reads_against.argmap: Forth-flowing drop-resonance; pure-nectar self. → Bow to Śaṅkara milk-ocean, pure-nectar self, endless light.
c1_essence: Milk-ocean Śaṅkara bowed; hate and praise both address Ambikā's husband who holds the all.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: To the forth-flowing drop and resonance, to the self made of pure nectar: bow; to endless light, to Śaṅkara, the milk-ocean.
